description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

DRS RADA Technologies, a subsidiary of Leonardo DRS, is hiring a Software Engineer I/II to develop, test, and sustain software supporting advanced radar systems. The role focuses on C/C++ application software, system-level interfaces, and integration and troubleshooting across engineering teams.
Software Engineer I/II developing and testing C/C++ radar-system software, debugging real-time behavior and supporting system integration

Responsibilities:
• Help design, develop, test, debug, and maintain software applications and system components that operate and support advanced radar systems
• Implement C/C++ software features from defined requirements, design guidance, and existing system architecture
• Contribute to radar-system application software involving multithreaded behavior, timing-sensitive operation, shared resources, and system-level interfaces
• Troubleshoot and resolve software issues found during development, integration, lab testing, system testing, and field support, with support from senior engineers as needed
• Work with software, systems, hardware, integration, and test engineers to understand system behavior, support integration activities, and resolve issues
• Participate in code reviews, configuration management, documentation, estimation, and engineering process improvements
• Learn relevant domain concepts such as radar-system operation, real-time software behavior, hardware/software integration, and mission-critical software development
• Grow technical ownership over time by contributing to increasingly complex software tasks, debugging efforts, and integration activities

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience
• For Software Engineer I: entry-level candidates are welcome, including those with internship, academic project, or other relevant software development experience
• For Software Engineer II: at least two years of relevant software engineering experience, or equivalent experience
• Experience developing software in C or C++, including academic, internship, project, or professional experience
• Familiarity with core software concepts such as data structures, debugging, memory management, concurrency, operating systems, or performance tradeoffs
• Ability to build, test, debug, and maintain software as part of a collaborative engineering team
• Interest in system-level, embedded, real-time, or mission-critical software applications
• Experience using version control and software development tools
• Ability and interest to learn complex technical domains, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively with software, systems, hardware, integration, and test engineers
• U.S. citizenship is required
• the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance may be needed for future program work
• the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment

Preferred:
• Preferred but not required: experience with RTOS-based or Linux-based software development, especially in hardware-integrated environments
